cards.name: Sol Ring
cards.why: Two mana on turn one, and it always has been: the single most played card in the format, the first thing every primer tells a newcomer to find, and the card this line exists to make room for -- which is why it is first.

notes.mulligan:
Keep any seven with two lands and an equipment; ship a hand
with no knight by turn three.
notes.politics: The table forgets Ashvale until it is too late: say nothing.
notes.weird: colon: and # hash, plus braces {G}{W} and a trailing space

strategy: Suit up a knight and swing: Syr Gwyn's trigger draws a card and the equipment costs nothing, so every turn after the third is a cantrip with a sword attached -- panache *and* martial prowess.
